items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### Design

*   [APPLORE](https://applore.app/ai-app-icon-generator) - AI app icon generator plus a library of 18,000+ real App Store and Google Play icons for reference. `#freemium` `#design`

### Developer Tools

*   [CodeTrendy](https://codetrendy.com/) - Curated directory of newly launched startups, SaaS and AI tools, with a free read-only remote MCP server (<https://codetrendy.com/api/mcp>) that lets AI assistants search listings, read profiles and find alternatives, no API key. `#free` `#mcp`
*   [deed.page](https://deed.page/) - Static hosting built for AI coding agents: one PUT (REST or remote MCP server) publishes HTML or a folder to a permanent HTTPS URL, with no account needed. `#freemium` `#hosting`
*   [MEDIAPRONET](https://mediapronet.com/) - Launch and discovery directory where builders list newly shipped startups, SaaS tools and online products, with a free read-only remote MCP server (<https://mediapronet.com/api/mcp>) for searching listings, reading profiles and finding alternatives from AI assistants, no API key. `#free` `#mcp`

### Productivity

*   [Orkas](https://orkas.ai/?source=gh_collective\&lang=en) - Turns project goals and local files into reports, presentations and code with a coordinated AI team in an open-source, local-first desktop workspace, using managed models or supported own-provider access. `#opensource`

### Research

*   [Pulse](https://pulsecorp.co/) - AI-moderated market research platform that runs customer interviews at scale. `#paid`

### Resume

*   [HireDraftAI](https://hiredraftai.com/) - AI-assisted resumes and cover letters with free anonymous tools for reviewing keywords and planning job applications. `#freemium` `#writing`

### Video

*   [pitchboom.io](https://pitchboom.io) - Turns a product URL or a short brief into motion-design video ads with script, storyboard, voice-over and music, in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4. `#freemium`
*   [Vidney](https://vidney.ai/) - Multi-model AI video and image generator that runs 40+ models, including Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Grok Imagine and Nano Banana, on one credit balance. `#freemium`

items.title: Awesome Amazon Seller
items.content_text:
### Software and Tools

*   [ChineseCheck](https://chinesecheck.com) - Verify a Chinese supplier before paying: look up the company by English name, Chinese name or Unified Social Credit Code and read its registration record in English for free; paid reports add court enforcement, litigation and penalty records.
*   [ScrapeUnblocker](https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com/plugins/amazon) - Web scraping API with Amazon endpoints that return JSON: product pages (price, list price, availability, rating, seller, images), search results with sponsored and Prime flags, Best Sellers and other ranked lists, and review data with the star histogram, across Amazon's regional marketplaces. Also available as an MCP server.
*   [RefVid](https://refvid.com) - AI product video generator that keeps label, logo and packaging consistent across clips, from 1-5 photos or an Amazon product link. Free credits on sign-up.
*   [Utlista](https://www.utlista.com) - Localises an existing product catalogue into Amazon listings for seven EU marketplaces (de, fr, it, es, nl, pl, se). Writes title, five bullets, description and backend search terms per destination marketplace rather than translating them, and validates every field against Amazon's limits before export, including search terms counted in bytes. Produces a flat file per marketplace; it does not upload to Amazon. Free for ten products.
*   [Vendooly](https://vendooly.com/en/) - MCP connector that brings Seller Central and Amazon Ads into ChatGPT and Claude through the official Amazon APIs. The AI prepares each change with a before/after preview and it runs only after your approval. 14-day free trial.
*   [VNCNT Labs Keyword Research](https://apify.com/vncntlabs/keyword-ideas) - Reverse ASIN (the Amazon keywords any ASIN ranks for) and keyword ideas from a seed via Amazon related searches and Google autocomplete, with search volume, CPC, difficulty and a USPTO trademark flag. Runs on Apify, pay per result from $0.002 per keyword, no subscription.

items.title: Awesome Eslint
items.content_text:
### Plugins / Code Quality

*   [@a11yfred/eslint-plugin-neighbor (⭐1)](https://github.com/a11yfred/neighbor) - Enforces accessibility, inclusive language, and markup best practices.

### Plugins / Internationalization

*   [I18n Leak (⭐0)](https://github.com/Sloppy0726/eslint-plugin-i18n-leak) - Finds i18n bugs with no string literal to scan: form constraints whose validation message the browser renders in its own locale, and raw `error.message` text reaching the user.
*   [i18next (⭐175)](https://github.com/edvardchen/eslint-plugin-i18next) - Finds untranslated string literals in source, with `markupOnly` and `jsx-only` modes to narrow the scan.

### Plugins / Practices and Specific ES Features

*   [import-next (⭐18)](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-import-next) - Drop-in replacement for `eslint-plugin-import` with a rewritten cycle detector and no config changes required.
*   [import-boundary (⭐7)](https://github.com/nayounsang/eslint-plugin-import-boundary) - Enforces import boundaries from directory nesting: only a parent may import a direct child's public entry (`index`), with `rootFiles` / `sharedFiles` escapes.
*   [eslint-plugin-intlayer (⭐855)](https://github.com/aymericzip/intlayer/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-intlayer) - ESLint plugin for i18n purpose.

### Plugins / Security

*   [secure-coding (⭐18)](https://github.com/ofri-peretz/eslint/tree/main/packages/eslint-plugin-secure-coding) - Security rules with CWE and OWASP Top 10 metadata, and machine-readable fix guidance in each message.
*   [typeorm-enterprise (⭐0)](https://github.com/alokraj68/eslint-plugin-typeorm-enterprise) - TypeORM security and governance: SQL injection prevention, transaction safety, and multi-tenant query guards.

### Tools / Testing Tools

*   [quick-gate-js (⭐5)](https://github.com/hermes-labs-ai/quick-gate-js) - Deterministic CI quality gate that unifies ESLint, TypeScript, build, and Lighthouse checks into one fail-fast result, with bounded auto-repair and structured escalation evidence. npm: `quick-gate`.

items.title: Awesome Swift
items.content_text:
### Newsletter

*   [The iOS Weekly Brief](https://iosweeklybrief.com) - A weekly newsletter with Must/Quick Read picks, a Toolbox section, the iOS job market, and upcoming conferences, each with commentary on why it matters.

### Third party Guides

*   [Swift & SwiftUI Tutorials](https://janeshsutharios.github.io/TechBlogs/) - SwiftUI learning with Ease.
*   [Swift Learning Roadmap (⭐225)](https://github.com/asimcanyagiz/Swift-Roadmap) - A learning path with Turkish resources covering Swift fundamentals and iOS development.

### Vim

*   [vim-polyglot (⭐5.7k)](https://github.com/vim-polyglot/vim-polyglot) - Language pack for vim that includes vim-swift.

### Misc

*   [BerryDB Desktop (⭐24)](https://github.com/berry-apps/berrydb-desktop) - Native macOS database client for SQL and NoSQL databases with an optional AI assistant.
*   [Device Hub Pro (⭐1)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - A SwiftUI Mac app that mirrors and controls Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side.
*   [Oh My Android (⭐60)](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android) - A macOS control panel for the Android Emulator with one-click toggles and a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

### AI

*   [Fazm (⭐347)](https://github.com/mediar-ai/fazm) - A voice-controlled AI agent for macOS using accessibility APIs and ScreenCaptureKit.
*   [Grux (⭐30)](https://github.com/dotcomjack/grux) - A local-first AI agent app for macOS with mail, calendar, meeting tools, and support for Ollama or your own API key.

### Chart

*   [SwiftSunburstDiagram (⭐551)](https://github.com/lludo/SwiftSunburstDiagram) - SwiftUI library to render sunburst diagrams (multilevel pie / ring charts) from a tree of objects.

### Colors

*   [PaletteKit (⭐28)](https://github.com/2dubu/PaletteKit) - Extracts dominant colors and renders adaptive SwiftUI and UIKit graphics from any image.

### Images / Barcode

*   [ATGMediaBrowser (⭐214)](https://github.com/ounass-tech/ATGMediaBrowser) - Image slide-show viewer with multiple predefined transition styles, and with ability to create new transitions with ease.
*   [PaintKit (⭐50)](https://github.com/joshlin2201/itspaint) - Raster drawing engine with no UI and no dependencies.

### Localization / Barcode

*   [StringSwitch](https://fabdurso.com/en/stringswitch/) - Easily convert iOS .strings files to Android strings.xml format and vice versa.

### Mock / Barcode

*   [swift-sourcery-templates (⭐21)](https://github.com/modaal-agent/swift-sourcery-templates) - Sourcery templates for generating protocol mocks, type erasures, and dependency-forwarding classes.

### Text / Barcode

*   [MarkdownEngine (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/nodes-app/swift-markdown-engine) - A native AppKit Markdown editor for macOS with live styling, wiki-style links, and LaTeX rendering, built on TextKit 2.

### UI / Barcode

*   [OverlayContainer (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/gaetanzanella/OverlayContainer) - OverlayContainer makes it easier to develop overlay based interfaces, such as the one presented in the Apple Maps or Stocks apps.

### Menu / Barcode

*   [ENSwiftSideMenu (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/devgenios/ENSwiftSideMenu) - Sliding side menu.
*   [InteractiveSideMenu (⭐694)](https://github.com/raw-materials/InteractiveSideMenu) - Customizable iOS Interactive Side Menu.

### Utility / Barcode

*   [Closures (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/dusty-commits/Closures) - Swifty closures for UIKit and Foundation.

### Validation / Barcode

*   [ATGValidator (⭐51)](https://github.com/ounass-tech/ATGValidator) - Rule based validation framework with form and card validation support for iOS.

items.title: Magictools
items.content_text:
### Engines and Frameworks / Voxel Editors

*   :tada: [Proof Engine (⭐31)](https://github.com/Mattbusel/proof-engine) - Rust rendering and game engine where every visual is math: glyphs and particles moved by ODEs, strange attractors and force fields, with OpenGL post-processing and synth audio.

### AI / Voxel Editors

*   :tada: [Glitchless (⭐0)](https://github.com/glitchless-gg/glitchless) - Open-source game observability for Three.js, Phaser, Unity, Godot, Unreal and GameMaker: frame times with hitch causes, crashes, where players quit and player bug reports, plus an MCP server so coding agents can read the data and fix what players hit.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### MCP Servers

*   [BlockVectra (⭐0)](https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp) - MCP server for Robinhood Chain and multiple EVM networks. Connect over remote Streamable HTTP to discover chains and read docs without a key; RPC access follows each chain's policy, while Data API and account tools need an API key. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp --ref main`.
